configuration.warmup: One Ready per warm process, one register, one API issue; setup and warmups excluded.
configuration.sequence: 1-owner cold then warm; 7-owner cold then warm; each operation loop serial in listed order. Valid login resets throttling before each wrong-password sample.

boundaries.scope: local workerd, synthetic credentials, task-owned primary D1 SQLite databases
boundaries.timing: External Node process.hrtime.bigint from before fetch to fully consumed response body; includes local HTTP, JSON, fresh App resolution/activation, operation, shutdown, instrumentation. Cold starts begin before Miniflare construction and include workerd launch/artifact loading.
boundaries.cold: New workerd process and Wasm instance using the same release artifact and initialized D1 files; OS page/filesystem caches are not flushed. Build, key generation and schema setup excluded.
boundaries.warm: Existing workerd isolate, fresh App and event storage scope for every request. Runner generation numbers expose normal retirement/reset; rotation samples are retained and counted.
boundaries.memory: Wasm memory.buffer.byteLength at event entry, D1 boundaries and completion; allocated linear memory, not live heap, RSS or CPU. Within-generation memory does not shrink, so growth during synchronous Argon2 remains observable at return. Boundary samples are not a full peak profiler.
boundaries.d1: Owner batch attempts and statement counts; returned rows separate from optional local result.meta rows_read/rows_written. No D1 duration is used as CPU. Failed batches may have unknown committed work. Setup/control-plane queries excluded.
boundaries.oidc: Real OIDC Provider activation including unchanged RSA key-match validation, then metadata and public JWKS probes. No external IdP exchange, browser login or cloud egress is measured.
boundaries.statistics: Descriptive small samples: p99 is the maximum for n=30 and n=5. No confidence interval or cross-machine performance claim.
